subtitle: The Hero's War · the Trinity Sight System
intro: A concise, spoiler-aware milestone guide to Suikoden III. Follow Hugo, Chris, Geddoe and Thomas through the Trinity Sight chapters, see which Stars of Destiny each chapter unlocks, and clear the all-104 gate before Chapter 6. Original content — not copied from any guide.

chapters.title: 1 · The Trinity Sight
chapters.context: Suikoden III is told through three pairs of eyes — Hugo of the Grasslands, Chris of the Zexen Knights, and the mercenary Geddoe — plus young Thomas. You play their opening chapters in any order; their paths cross and finally merge under one flag.

steps.text: Pick a protagonist to begin — Hugo, Chris or Geddoe (Thomas unlocks after).
Tip: you'll replay events from each side. What one hero misses, another may see.
Tip: progress is shared across all four story windows of this guide.

chapters.title: 2 · Hugo · Chapter 1 — The Grasslands
chapters.context: Hugo of the Karaya Clan, his griffon Fubar and the warrior Sgt. Joe carry a peace offering to the Zexen Federation — only for the fragile truce between Grasslanders and knights to shatter.

steps.text: Play Hugo's first chapter and deliver the message to Zexen.
Hugo, Sgt. Joe and Fubar join automatically.

chapters.title: 3 · Chris · Chapter 1 — The Silver Maiden
chapters.context: Chris Lightfellow leads the Zexen Knights — Salome, Borus, Percival, Roland, Leo and squire Louis. Bound by a council that distrusts them, they ride against the Grassland clans.

steps.text: Play Chris's first chapter with the Zexen Knights.
All six knights and squire Louis join automatically.

chapters.title: 4 · Geddoe · Chapter 1 — The Mercenaries
chapters.context: Geddoe's unit — Ace, Joker, Queen, Jacques and the bishop Sasarai's hidden agenda — works the Grasslands for Harmonia. After Karaya burns they take in the survivor Aila.

steps.text: Play Geddoe's first chapter with his mercenary unit.
Geddoe's squad joins automatically; Aila joins after Karaya burns.

chapters.title: 5 · Thomas · Chapter 1 — Budehuc Castle
chapters.context: Disowned noble's son Thomas is handed the run-down Budehuc Castle and its motley staff. This neutral ground will become the home base of the army to come.

steps.text: Play Thomas's chapter and take charge of Budehuc Castle.
The whole Budehuc staff joins automatically with Thomas.
Tip: Budehuc is your hub — most optional Stars are recruited here in Chapter 4.

chapters.title: 6 · Chapter 2 — Paths Cross
chapters.context: Each hero's second chapter deepens the war: Hugo seeks allies among the clans, Chris uncovers rot inside the Federation, and Nash and others slip into the story.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 2 segment for each protagonist you're following.
Hugo's allies (Reed, Samus, Lilly) and Chris's Nash join automatically.

chapters.title: 7 · Chapter 3 — The War Widens
chapters.context: The Hero's War spreads across the Grasslands. Hugo gains Hallec and Mua; Chris is joined by Rico, Fred and Yun as the truth about the Zexen council surfaces.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 3 segment for each protagonist.
Hallec, Mua (Hugo) and Rico, Fred, Yun (Chris) join automatically.

chapters.title: 8 · Chapter 4 — The Fire Bringer
chapters.context: The three armies unite at Budehuc under one banner — the reborn Fire Bringer. With Caesar and Apple guiding strategy, this is the great recruiting chapter: nearly every optional Star of Destiny can be gathered now.

steps.text: Unite the armies at Budehuc Castle as the Fire Bringer.
Caesar, Apple, Jimba, Lucia and the chapter leaders join automatically.
Tip: this is your main recruiting window — most OPTIONAL Stars below have their own item, party, or quest condition.
Tip: recruit widely now — Chapter 6 locks anyone you don't already have.

chapters.title: 9 · Chapter 5 — The True Runes Converge
chapters.context: The masked threat behind the war steps into the light and the True Runes draw together. Geddoe's confrontation here decides whether several of his world's people stand with you.

steps.text: Play through Chapter 5 toward the heart of the conspiracy.
Dios, Sasarai, Yumi and Yuiri join automatically.
⚠ During Geddoe's Chapter 5 battle, do NOT run away — flee and Elaine, Nicolas, Gau, Duke, Ruby, Iku and Franz are lost.

chapters.title: 10 · Chapter 6 — The Final Battle
chapters.context: All paths end together against the true enemy of the Hero's War. The last four Stars only appear if every other Star is already in your ranks.

steps.text: ⛔ POINT OF NO RETURN — Chapter 6 is the finale. You CANNOT return to recruit once it begins.
⚠ TRUE-RECRUIT GATE: you must already have all 104 other Stars BEFORE Chapter 6, or Yuber, Albert, Sarah and Luc are lost forever.
Fight the Final Battle and end the Hero's War.
